mission: Re-test only the exact two frozen reopening events using newly identified public pre-T0 sources.
acceptance_rules_inherited_unchanged: Every consensus field must be explicit and attributable to the frozen event.
Publication/vintage must be strictly before T0.
Timezone must be resolved or bounded strongly enough to prove pre-T0.
Immutable version or auditable version history is required.
Conflicting consensus snapshots are never averaged.
No outcome data may inform source acceptance.
important_note: This authority was created after discovery of a new public route. It is not represented as a pre-discovery freeze. Acceptance criteria are inherited verbatim from the 2026-09-21 closeout and are not modified in response to source values.
